candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record supports MDS with excess blasts (5% CD34+ myeloblasts, ALIP, dysmegakaryopoiesis, complex karyotype with 5q and 7q deletions) meeting RAEB-1 criteria, and the skin biopsy showing atypical myeloperoxidase/CD15/CD43-positive mononuclear cells with vascular damage constitutes leukaemic vasculitis. C001 captures only the MDS parent entity with one cytogenetic finding (5q deletion) but misses the RAEB-1 subtype and the defining leukaemic vasculitis manifestation that together form the full benchmark composite.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Identifies MDS and notes the 5q deletion but omits the RAEB-1 subtype specification and entirely omits the leukaemic vasculitis component, which is a required composite element of the benchmark diagnosis

case_quality_flags: Benchmark diagnosis is a composite requiring both MDS subtype (RAEB-1) and leukaemic vasculitis; candidates must address both components for complete equivalence
5q deletion alone does not define the MDS subtype here given co-existing 7q deletion and complex karyotype; isolated 5q- syndrome is a distinct WHO entity
